evidence.statement: The linked LC-PRIM-0006 interval overlaps the Domain V peptidyl-transferase catalytic neighborhood and includes A2058/G2061; part of the same exact sequence is recognized by TLR13 and A2058 is a known antibiotic-resistance target.
Codebook abstraction: PTC_GATE — a conserved active-site-adjacent sequence surface at the peptide-bond-forming machinery, also exposed to antibiotic and innate-immune recognition.

unknowns: Exact mechanistic contribution of every nucleotide in the 17-mer to catalysis versus structural positioning/recognition.
